intro.paragraph1: Sitesynergy ("Sitesynergy", "we", "us") builds site-selection and potential-assessment tools that combine geospatial data, analytics, and visualization to help organizations evaluate locations efficiently. We know you care about how your data is collected, used, and protected — this Privacy Policy explains what we collect, how we use it, and the controls available to you when using our web apps, maps, services, and integrations (together, the "Services").
intro.paragraph2: If you need to contact us about privacy matters, email privacy@sitesynergy.com or use the contact form in the app.

dataCollection.title: Types of Information We Collect
dataCollection.description: We collect information necessary to provide, secure, and improve the Services. Below is a summary of the categories of data we may collect.

account.title: Account & Profile Information
account.description: When you create an account or sign up for paid features, we collect information you provide (name, business name, email, role, billing details) and associate it with your account.

project.title: Project & Geodata
project.description: To evaluate sites we may store project metadata you create (site boundaries, feature selections, scenario settings) and any geospatial files or layers you upload to the platform.

usage.title: Usage & Interaction Data
usage.description: We log actions you take in the app (map interactions, layer toggles, analyses run) to help improve the product, reproduce issues, and provide collaborative features.

device.title: Device & Connection Information
device.description: We collect technical data such as IP address, browser and device type, and performance metrics to secure the Services and deliver a reliable experience.

dataCollection.note: This document also describes our security posture, optional cloud interactions, and how we treat customer data used with modelling or export features.

localFirst.title: Local-first & Minimum-data Design
localFirst.description: Sitesynergy is designed to limit data exposure by default. Project files, intermediate analysis, and local settings remain on the user's device or tenancy unless you explicitly choose cloud features that require transfer.

enterprise.title: Enterprise-grade infrastructure
enterprise.description: When you opt into hosted or collaborative features we operate on industry-standard infrastructure and controls to protect customer data. For customers with specific compliance needs we offer enterprise deployment options and contractual safeguards.

security.title: Continuous security testing
security.description: We perform regular security reviews and vulnerability assessments to identify and remediate issues proactively, and we keep dependencies and infrastructure up-to-date with best practices.

authentication.title: Secure authentication
authentication.description: Authentication uses industry-standard providers and supports single sign-on (SSO) and multi-factor authentication (MFA) for accounts that require stronger protections.

privacyByDesign.title: Privacy by design
privacyByDesign.description: Privacy considerations are built into Sitesynergy from the ground up:

localControl.title: Local control:
localControl.description: Project files, user-generated layers, and cached analysis remain under your control. Cloud transfers only occur when you explicitly enable sharing, backups, or cloud analysis.

scopedUploads.title: Scoped uploads:
scopedUploads.description: When cloud processing is used (for example, large-scale modelling or third-party model calls), only the minimal, relevant data required for that operation is transmitted — unrelated project data is not included.

permissionedSharing.title: Permissioned sharing:
permissionedSharing.description: Collaboration and sharing are opt-in and permissioned: you decide what to share, who can access it, and for how long.

privacyByDesign.conclusion: These design choices reduce risk and give teams flexible deployment patterns ranging from local-only desktop use to fully managed cloud collaboration.

cloudFeatures.title: Cloud features & data transfers
cloudFeatures.paragraph1: Optional cloud features (collaboration, hosted analytics, backup/restore) require data transfer. When you enable these features we take steps to limit what is sent and to protect it in transit and at rest.
cloudFeatures.paragraph2: For cloud modelling or third-party model calls, Sitesynergy pre-filters and scopes the payload to the prompt or analytic task — we do not send full user databases or unrelated project histories.
cloudFeatures.paragraph3: Backups are encrypted and can be created on-demand by users. There is no automatic, persistent sync unless you explicitly opt into a synchronization feature.

dataOwnership.title: Data ownership & model training
dataOwnership.paragraph1: You retain ownership of your project data and uploaded content. Sitesynergy does not use customer project data to train general-purpose models. Any model improvements derived from synthetic datasets or anonymized, consented telemetry are described in our product documentation and release notes.
dataOwnership.paragraph2: If you choose to participate in customer-feedback or opt-in improvement programs, we will obtain explicit consent and describe precisely what data will be used and for what purpose.
